Compiler, archive, flag probes and directory/file writes are effectful and covered by exact tools/search/header/loader/caller configuration basis. Target parser/llvm subprocess probes found in cfg(test) only. Parallel jobserver consumes Cargo scheduling tokens; original objects iterator feeds archive, not completion order. Selected GNU ar tries deterministic D modifier.

OUT_DIR flag_check source is fixed literal but reused if present: final selected executor refresh must start with fresh output namespace.

Filesystem metadata/symlink_metadata/read_dir selected by caller pattern. Entries sorted by filename before traversal. Absolute SCIP prefix lib wildcard candidates require namespace membership/content/symlink identity guard; glob package is not pure.

Runtime libclang loads exact file; clang include detection executes driver; parsed headers and C AST/IR produce tokens. Rustfmt runs selected pinned executable on stdin in package CWD. Time-phase timers write diagnostics and do not enter token output. Rustfmt failure falls back unformatted, so final evidence must record reached success/failure branch.

contracts.effect_contract: update/finalize consume caller-provided byte slices and in-memory state/padding, export big-endian digest. x86 CPUID selects software/SHA instruction implementation of same SHA256 transformation; no environment/filesystem/time lookup. Core/array helpers operate supplied state and lengths. Non-x86 HWCAP alternatives excluded by selected host.

contracts.helper: serde_json@1.0.151 build-helper variant and selected serde_core/itoa/memchr/zmij
contracts.effect_contract: Actual native callers pass already read receipt bytes to from_slice. SliceRead is sealed in-memory input; parser supplies bytes to existing typed Deserialize implementation. Primitive number/string/container implementations use supplied data; SystemTime Deserialize decodes input offset rather than reading clock, not used by receipt DTO. IoRead/from_reader are unselected. zmij/itoa serialization format supplied numbers; memchr CPUID dispatch searches supplied slices. Caller custom Deserialize source remains separately owned/reviewed.

Actual backend caller reads authored Cargo.toml once then from_str. DeTable parses source→lexer tokens→events→winnow TokenSlice→typed deserializer; no implicit file/include lookup, timezone/clock/date-now call. Datetime parses authored numeric calendar fields only. Debug/trace features absent in selected units; winnow debug COLUMNS lookup and parser debug diagnostics therefore excluded. Display helpers serialize supplied values only.

unreviewed_authorities: Compiler-provided macro/token semantics and third-party proc-macro helpers remain Compact source-review ownership. Newly selected feature/platform/caller/custom-deserializer changes require matching source review. Final native environmental/tool/header/loader/cache branch review is separate.
